description: This PHP test class 'EmployeeClaimRequestAPITest' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing the EmployeeClaimRequestAPI endpoints related to employee claims in the Claim API module. It includes setup methods and multiple data-driven test cases for create, getOne, and getAll endpoints.

classes.name: EmployeeClaimRequestAPITest
